lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: Sky's been promising rain since August.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Sky's a liar. Ask any man who planted corn.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: I planted beans. Beans don't care.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Did you hear the Meridian people bought the Ellery place?

lines.speaker: woman_old
lines.line: Bought it, or got it signed over?

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Way Martha tells it, there's a difference only on paper.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: Two bits says the four-ten is late again.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: No bet. It's always late. They print the timetable for the comedy.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: You still hauling for the mill?

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: When they pay. Last week they paid in promises.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Promises eat cheap. Feed your horse on 'em and see.

lines.speaker: woman_old
lines.line: That new preacher talks like a man who's never been hungry.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: Give him a winter. The Sable teaches humility for free.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Feed's up to a dollar ten the hundredweight.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: And cattle's down. Somebody in Port Linden is doing sums on us.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Somebody in Port Linden is always doing sums.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: There's a dance at the church hall Saturday.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: I've got two left feet and both of them hurt.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Then you'll fit right in with the fiddler.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: They say there's silver up past Coldwater still.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: They say a lot. Mostly the men who sell picks.

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: Sheriff's been riding out to the river every morning.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Then let him. Some things are better watched than talked about.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Hollis has calico in. Real calico, not that sacking.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: At what price?

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Don't ask the price. Ask to feel it first, then you'll pay.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: Pour me one for the road.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: You said that an hour ago.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: It's a long road.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Your boy back from the drive yet?

lines.speaker: woman_old
lines.line: Wrote from the railhead. Says the cattle lost weight and he gained sense.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: That's a fair trade, most years.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: You read the Lantern this week?

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Fenn's paper? I read it twice. Once to believe it, once to be scared.

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: Deal me in.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: With what? You owe the house already.

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: Then deal me out quiet, so it doesn't notice.

lines.speaker: woman_old
lines.line: I set bread to rise and the heat near baked it in the bowl.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: October, and still the stove's the cool part of the house.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Water's down another foot at the crossing.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: Saw it. You can read the old flood marks on the pilings like a ledger.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: And every page of it red.

lines.speaker: shopkeeper
lines.line: Morning, Mrs. Larkin. Coffee came in on the freight.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Honest coffee, or the kind that's half chicory?

lines.speaker: shopkeeper
lines.line: Honest as I am, ma'am.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: Then I'll take a pound and watch you weigh it.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: Stranger in town. Woman, rides a good horse.

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: Saw her. Wears that iron like she knows what it weighs.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: Then mind your manners, and your hands.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: Forty years I've watched that road.

lines.speaker: woman_old
lines.line: And what's it brought you?

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: You, for one. And taxes.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: Land office posted new survey lines on the board.

lines.speaker: man_young
lines.line: Lines on paper don't move fences.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: No. Men with paper hire men who do.

lines.speaker: woman_town
lines.line: School needs a new stove before the cold.

lines.speaker: man_old
lines.line: Pass the hat Sunday. The Lord likes a warm schoolhouse.

lines.speaker: man_rough
lines.line: Whiskey's thinner than last month.

lines.speaker: man_town
lines.line: So's your credit.
